mainEntity.name: What is memecoin marketing and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Memecoin marketing is a coordinated campaign combining KOL seeding, community building and earned media to drive awareness and holder growth for a memecoin or community token. It is most effective for founders who have a live token or are within four to eight weeks of launch and want to build genuine community before the KOL wave, not after.

mainEntity.name: How much does memecoin marketing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: KOL costs vary by tier: nano influencers run $200–$1.5K per post, micro $500–$5K, mid-tier $10K–$30K and macro $25K–$100K+. On top of KOL fees, the operator retainer for campaign strategy, vetting, briefing and management runs $5K–$12K/month as a fractional senior operator, versus $15K–$45K/month at a full agency. A single launch sprint with a defined KOL wave typically totals $15K–$40K all-in over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and KOL tiers do you use for memecoins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twitter/X is the primary platform for memecoin culture. Telegram and Discord are essential for community conversion. TikTok and YouTube Shorts work well for nano and micro tiers targeting broader retail audiences. The tier mix depends on your budget and target demographic: community-native memecoins typically weight nano and micro heavily, while projects targeting exchange listings also bring in one or two mid-tier names for credibility signalling.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle disclosure and compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every KOL brief includes mandatory disclosure language (#ad or #sponsored per FTC guidelines) and a clause requiring the KOL to retain the post for a minimum period. This is non-negotiable, because undisclosed paid promotion creates legal exposure for the project and can be flagged by exchanges during listing due diligence. Projects that run clean campaigns from day one have a materially better listing conversation.
